1: // js/map.js — construtor de grid para DOOM clone
2: // Funções puras, sem dependências, TDD-ready

4: import C from './constants.js';

6: // WHY: normaliza cada linha do mapa bruto para gridW chars
7: const normalizeRow = (row) => {
8:   return row.padEnd(C.MAP.gridW).slice(0, C.MAP.gridW);
9: };

11: // WHY: garante que todas as linhas tenham o mesmo comprimento
12: const padGrid = (grid) => {
13:   const maxLen = Math.max(...grid.map((r) => r.length));
14:   return grid.map((row) => normalizeRow(row.padEnd(maxLen)));
15: };
16: 
17: // WHY: mapa bruto — 36 cols x 44 rows
18: // Spawn (18,22) = floor com 4 vizinhos livres

66:   { name: 'hall', color: 0x22aa44, minRow: 2, maxRow: 14, minCol: 6, maxCol: 19 },
67:   { name: 'corridor', color: 0x2244aa, minRow: 15, maxRow: 27, minCol: 6, maxCol: 19 },

71:   { name: 'arena', color: 0xff8800, minRow: 32, maxRow: 41, minCol: 6, maxCol: 33 },
72: ];
73: 
74: // WHY: espalha pickups aleatoriamente na zona segura
75: const SPREAD_PICKUPS = (grid, count, types) => {
76:   const spawns = { x: C.PLAYER.startPos.x, z: C.PLAYER.startPos.z };
77:   const occupied = new Set();
78:   occupied.add(`${spawns.x},${spawns.z}`);
79: 
80:   const tryPlace = () => {
81:     let x, z;
82:     do {
83:       x = Math.floor(Math.random() * (grid.length - 2)) + 1;
84:       z = Math.floor(Math.random() * (grid[0].length - 2)) + 1;
85:     } while (occupied.has(`${x},${z}`));
86: 
87:     const cell = grid[x][z];
88:     const isWall = cell === C.TILES.WALL;
89:     const isBorder = x <= 0 || x >= grid.length - 1 || z <= 0 || z >= grid[0].length - 1;
90:     const isSpawn = `${x},${z}` === `${spawns.x},${spawns.z}`;
91:     if (!isWall && !isBorder && !isSpawn) return { x, z };
92:   };
93: 
94:   const pickups = [];
95:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
96:     const pos = tryPlace();
97:     if (pos) {
98:       const type = types[Math.floor(Math.random() * types.length)];
99:       pickups.push({ x: pos.x, z: pos.z, type });
100:       occupied.add(`${pos.x},${pos.z}`);
101:     } else break;
102:   }
103:   return pickups;
104: };
105: 
106: // WHY: coloca torches ao longo das paredes
107: const PLACE_TORCHES = (grid, count) => {
108:   const occupied = new Set();
109:   occupied.add(`${C.PLAYER.startPos.x},${C.PLAYER.startPos.z}`);
110: 
111:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
112:     let x, z;
113:     do {
114:       x = Math.floor(Math.random() * (grid.length - 2)) + 1;
115:       z = Math.floor(Math.random() * (grid[0].length - 2)) + 1;
116:     } while (occupied.has(`${x},${z}`));
117: 
118:     const cell = grid[x][z];
119:     const isWall = cell === C.TILES.WALL;
120:     const isBorder = x <= 0 || x >= grid.length - 1 || z <= 0 || z >= grid[0].length - 1;
121:     const isSpawn = `${x},${z}` === `${C.PLAYER.startPos.x},${C.PLAYER.startPos.z}`;
122:     if (!isWall && !isBorder && !isSpawn) {
123:       occupied.add(`${x},${z}`);
124:       return { x, z };
125:     }
126:   }
127:   return [];
128: };
129: 
130: // WHY: constrói o nível completo
131: const buildLevel = () => {
132:   let grid = RAW_MAP.map(normalizeRow);
133:   grid = padGrid(grid);
134: 
135:   // WHY: valida o spawn
136:   const spawnX = C.PLAYER.startPos.x;
137:   const spawnZ = C.PLAYER.startPos.z;
138:   if (grid[spawnZ][spawnX] === C.TILES.WALL) {
139:     throw new Error('Spawn em parede!');
140:   }
141:   const neighbors = [
142:     grid[spawnZ - 1][spawnX],
143:     grid[spawnZ + 1][spawnX],
144:     grid[spawnZ][spawnX - 1],
145:     grid[spawnZ][spawnX + 1],
146:   ];
147:   for (const n of neighbors) {
148:     if (n === C.TILES.WALL) throw new Error('Spawn cercado por parede!');
149:   }
150: 
151:   const pickups = SPREAD_PICKUPS(grid, 20, ['H', 'A', 'W']);
152:   const doors = SPREAD_PICKUPS(grid, 8, ['D']);
153:   const exits = SPREAD_PICKUPS(grid, 2, ['S']);
154:   const secrets = SPREAD_PICKUPS(grid, 1, ['!']);
155:   const torches = PLACE_TORCHES(grid, 10);
156:   const lava = SPREAD_PICKUPS(grid, 5, ['L']);
157: 
158:   for (const p of pickups) grid[p.z][p.x] = p.type;
159:   for (const d of doors) grid[d.z][d.x] = d.type;
160:   for (const e of exits) grid[e.z][e.x] = e.type;
161:   for (const s of secrets) grid[s.z][s.x] = s.type;
162:   for (const t of torches) grid[t.z][t.x] = C.TILES.TORCH;
163:   for (const l of lava) grid[l.z][l.x] = C.TILES.LAVA;
164: 
165:   const playerSpawn = { x: spawnX, z: spawnZ, yaw: Math.PI / 2 };
166:   const exitsList = exits.map((e) => ({ x: e.x, z: e.z }));
167:   const secretsList = secrets.map((s) => ({ x: s.x, z: s.z }));
168:   const doorsList = doors.map((d) => ({ x: d.x, z: d.z, state: 'closed' }));
169:   const lavaList = lava.map((l) => ({ x: l.x, z: l.z }));
170: 
171:   return { grid, zones: ZONES, playerSpawn, exits: exitsList, secrets: secretsList, torches, pickups, doors: doorsList, lava: lavaList };
172: };
173: 
174: // WHY: verifica se uma célula é parede
175: const isWall = (grid, x, z) => {
176:   if (z < 0 || z >= grid.length || x < 0 || x >= grid[0].length) return true;
177:   return grid[z][x] === C.TILES.WALL;
178: };
179: 
180: // WHY: verifica se um tile é sólido (parede ou porta fechada)
181: const isSolidTile = (ch) => {
182:   return ch === C.TILES.WALL || ch === C.TILES.DOOR;
183: };
184: 
185: // WHY: retorna o tile em uma posição
186: const cellAt = (grid, x, z) => {
187:   if (z < 0 || z >= grid.length || x < 0 || x >= grid[0].length) return C.TILES.WALL;
188:   return grid[z][x];
189: };
190: 
191: // WHY: raycasting DDA para verificar linha de visão
192: const hasLineOfSight = (grid, x0, z0, x1, z1, doors = []) => {
193:   let dx = x1 - x0;
194:   let dz = z1 - z0;
195:   const steps = Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dz));
196:   if (steps === 0) return true;
197: 
198:   const sx = dx / steps;
199:   const sz = dz / steps;
200: 
201:   let curX = x0;
202:   let curZ = z0;
203:   for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
204:     const tx = Math.floor(curX + 0.5);
205:     const tz = Math.floor(curZ + 0.5);
206:     if (tx < 0 || tx >= grid[0].length || tz < 0 || tz >= grid.length) return false;
207:     const tile = grid[tz][tx];
208:     if (tile === C.TILES.WALL) return false;
209:     const doorIdx = doors.findIndex((d) => d.x === tx && d.z === tz);
210:     if (doorIdx !== -1 && doors[doorIdx].state === 'closed') return false;
211:     curX += sx;
212:     curZ += sz;
213:   }
214:   return true;
215: };
216: 
217: export {
218:   buildLevel,
219:   isWall,
220:   isSolidTile,
221:   cellAt,
222:   hasLineOfSight,
223:   normalizeRow,
224:   padGrid,
225:   RAW_MAP,
226:   ZONES,
227: };

1: // js/move.js — física pura para DOOM clone
2: // Sem dependências, testável em node
3: 
4: import C from './constants.js';
5: import { R_y, clamp } from './utils.js';
6: 
7: // WHY: aplica gravidade ao vetor de velocidade
8: const applyGravity = (vel, dt) => {
9:   vel.y += C.PHYSICS.gravity * dt;
10:   vel.y = clamp(vel.y, C.PHYSICS.maxFall, C.PHYSICS.gravity * 0);
11:   return vel;
12: };
13: 
14: // WHY: aplica atrito ou resistência do ar
15: const applyFriction = (vel, dt, onGround) => {
16:   if (onGround) {
17:     vel.x *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.friction * dt;
18:     vel.z *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.friction * dt;
19:   } else {
20:     vel.x *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.airResist * dt;
21:     vel.z *= 1 - C.PHYSICS.airResist * dt;
22:   }
23:   return vel;
24: };
25: 
26: // WHY: acelera o jogador na direção desejada
27: const accelerate = (vel, wishdir, accel, dt) => {
28:   vel.x += wishdir.x * accel * dt;
29:   vel.z += wishdir.z * accel * dt;
30:   return vel;
31: };
32: 
33: // WHY: move e resolve colisão AABB por eixo
34: const moveAxis = (pos, vel, axis, dt, grid, radius) => {
35:   const newVel = { ...vel };
36:   const newPos = { ...pos };
37: 
38:   // WHY: eixo complementar (y é o eixo "outro" no teste)
39:   const other = axis === 'x' ? 'y' : 'x';
40:   const oldMain = pos[axis];
41:   const oldOther = pos[other];
42:   const newMain = pos[axis] + vel[axis] * dt;
43:   const newOther = pos[other] + vel[other] * dt;
44: 
45:   if (axis === 'x') {
46:     const xMin = Math.floor(oldMain - radius);
47:     const xMax = Math.floor(newMain + radius);
48:     const yMin = Math.floor(oldOther - radius);
49:     const yMax = Math.floor(newOther + radius);
50: 
51:     const hitLeft = grid[yMin][xMin] === C.TILES.WALL;
52:     const hitRight = grid[yMax][xMax] === C.TILES.WALL;
53:     const hitTop = grid[yMin][xMin + 1] === C.TILES.WALL || grid[yMin][xMax - 1] === C.TILES.WALL;
54:     const hitBottom = grid[yMax][xMin + 1] === C.TILES.WALL || grid[yMax][xMax - 1] === C.TILES.WALL;
55: 
56:     if (hitLeft || hitRight || hitTop || hitBottom) {
57:       newVel.x = 0;
58:       newPos.x = oldMain + vel.x * dt;
59:       newPos.x = clamp(newPos.x, oldMain - radius, oldMain + radius);
60:     }
61:   } else {
62:     const zMin = Math.floor(oldOther - radius);
63:     const zMax = Math.floor(newOther + radius);
64:     const xMin = Math.floor(oldMain - radius);
65:     const xMax = Math.floor(newMain + radius);
66: 
67:     const hitFront = grid[zMin][xMin] === C.TILES.WALL;
68:     const hitBack = grid[zMax][xMax] === C.TILES.WALL;
69:     const hitLeft = grid[zMin][xMin + 1] === C.TILES.WALL || grid[zMin][xMax - 1] === C.TILES.WALL;
70:     const hitRight = grid[zMax][xMin + 1] === C.TILES.WALL || grid[zMax][xMax - 1] === C.TILES.WALL;
71: 
72:     if (hitFront || hitBack || hitLeft || hitRight) {
73:       newVel.z = 0;
74:       newPos.z = oldOther + vel[other] * dt;
75:       newPos.z = clamp(newPos.z, oldOther - radius, oldOther + radius);
76:     }
77:   }
78: 
79:   const collided = newVel[axis] !== vel[axis];
80:   return { pos: newPos, vel: newVel, collided };
81: };
82: 
83: // WHY: aplica pulo quando no chão
84: const tryJump = (vel, onGround) => {
85:   if (onGround) vel.y = C.PHYSICS.jumpVel;
86:   return vel;
87: };
88: 
89: // WHY: aplica knockback ao jogador
90: const knockback = (vel, dirX, dirZ, force) => {
91:   vel.x += dirX * force * C.PHYSICS.BOUNCE;
92:   vel.z += dirZ * force * C.PHYSICS.BOUNCE;
93:   return vel;
94: };
95: 
96: // WHY: calcula dano de splash por distância
97: const splashDamage = (damage, dist, radius) => {
98:   if (dist > radius) return 0;
99:   if (dist === 0) return damage;
100:   return damage * (1 - dist / radius);
101: };
102: 
103: // WHY: bobbing da câmera
104: const cameraBob = (time, moving, speed) => {
105:   const bobAmp = C.PHYSICS.bobAmp;
106:   const bobFreq = C.PHYSICS.bobFreq;
107:   if (!moving) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
108:   return {
109:     x: Math.sin(time * bobFreq) * bobAmp,
110:     y: Math.sin(time * bobFreq * 2) * bobAmp * 0.5,
111:   };
112: };
113: 
114: export {
115:   applyGravity,
116:   applyFriction,
117:   accelerate,
118:   moveAxis,
119:   tryJump,
120:   knockback,
121:   splashDamage,
122:   cameraBob,
123: };

8:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(obj)) {
9:     frozen[k] = freezeAll(v);
10:   }
11:   return Object.freeze(frozen);
12: };

1: // js/utils.js — helpers puros (sem dependências)
2: // Todos exportados individualmente para TDD
3: 
4: const clamp = (v, min, max) => {
5:   return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v));
6: };
7: 
8: const lerp = (a, b, t) => {
9:   return a + (b - a) * t;
10: };
11: 
12: const deg2rad = (d) => {
13:   return (d * Math.PI) / 180;
14: };
15: 
16: // WHY: rotação positiva mantém movimento alinhado à câmera
17: // R_y(+yaw) = {x: sin(yaw), z: cos(yaw)} — ciclo correto para FPS
18: const R_y = (yaw) => {
19:   const sy = Math.sin(yaw);
20:   const cy = Math.cos(yaw);
21:   return { x: sy, z: cy };
22: };
23: 
24: const angleLerp = (a, b, t) => {
25:   // Shortest-path lerp entre ângulos (evita descontinuidade em ±π)
26:   let diff = b - a;
27:   if (diff > Math.PI) diff -= 2 * Math.PI;
28:   if (diff < -Math.PI) diff += 2 * Math.PI;
29:   return a + diff * clamp(t, 0, 1);
30: };
31: 
32: const dist2D = (ax, az, bx, bz) => {
33:   const dx = bx - ax;
34:   const dz = bz - az;
35:   return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
36: };
37: 
38: // mulberry32 — PRNG determinístico com seed
39: const mulberry32 = (seed) => {
40:   let s = seed >>> 0;
41:   return function () {
42:     s = (s + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0;
43:     let t = Math.imul(s ^ (s >>> 15), 1 | s);
44:     t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) >>> 0;
45:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
46:   };
47: };
48: 
49: export { clamp, lerp, deg2rad, R_y, angleLerp, dist2D, mulberry32 };
